name: Client Review Watch
office_task: Work out when each client's AML/CTF review is next due from our program's dated rules, and list everyone due or overdue, with their last review, for our compliance officer.
systems_of_record: the practice's client review register (its AML/CTF program's dated review rules by risk rating, each client's review obligation, and the document store signed review records are filed in)

emits.write: a signed client review record, attached to an email that names the review obligation id and the reviewer, filed as evidence of the completed review on that obligation; a 'reviewed' with no document or no named reviewer is never filed, and an email with no obligation id is never matched on a client name
emits.readback: the obligation is read back by its id and must return the same evidence reference (the message_id and attachment) and a completion date; if it does not, nothing was filed and cdd_review.record_not_read_back is raised

emits.write: an exception on the client's review obligation naming the compliance officer who owns it: a review coming due (with the rule version, due date and last review on file), an overdue review, a client with no review on file, no rule in force, a past date no retained rule version explains, a client who declined to update details, a change the client told us about, a drafted client information request awaiting a named release, a release with no named person, silence past the next chase date, or an email with no obligation id
emits.readback: the exception desk returns an exception_id, and reading that id back returns the obligation id, the reason and the exception_owner; no id back means nothing was raised and the run stops
